name: terraform-invalid-utf8-replaced
body: Invalid UTF-8 byte runs in a Terraform source are decoded lossily: each run becomes one U+FFFD in the decoded text while the offset map keeps raw on-disk byte offsets, so the file still parses and no diagnostic is emitted for the bad bytes. Upgrade to a per-file stderr diagnostic (or a parse failure) if the spec comes to require rejecting non-UTF-8 Terraform files.
